descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Test Engineer to join a team developing and testing embedded automotive and infotainment systems. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing manual and automated testing, analyzing software defects, and ensuring high-quality products across vehicle and bench environments.
 What you will do: 
Planning and executing structured, exploratory, regression, endurance, and automated software testing.
Reviewing requirements, creating and maintaining test cases, and ensuring traceability throughout software evolution.
Identifying, analyzing, verifying, and tracking software defects with detailed logs and supporting data.
Performing both vehicle and bench testing, including internal and customer test drives.
Analyzing test data using PC-based tools and test instrumentation.
Collaborating with different test teams to improve testing strategies and methodologies.
Supporting customer and internal technical workshops and troubleshooting activities.
Conducting retrospectives and contributing to continuous improvements in testing processes.
 What you need to have: 
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field.
5+ years of software testing experience.
2+ years of technical testing experience with 3GPP user equipment or similar technologies.
Good understanding of embedded systems, automotive products, and infotainment systems.
Understanding of software and hardware architectures and automotive telematics domains.
Knowledge of cellular technologies such as 4G/5G, LTE, WCDMA, GSM/GPRS, UMTS/HSxPA, as well as Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.
Experience with system testing methods, defect management, and testing tools.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, MS Office, and database tools.
Understanding of vehicle diagnostics and communication protocols.
Knowledge of V-Model software development processes.
ISTQB certification and knowledge of ASPICE.
Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 Nice-to-have qualifications: 
Experience with Android and Linux.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Python testing experience.
Hardware configuration and test setup experience.
Knowledge of ALM tools.
Programming experience.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
